description: Historical wildfire data : 2006 to 2025 is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Forestry and Parks. Dataset including information on wildfires in the province of Alberta from 2006 to 2025, inclusive. Information tracked for each fire includes: cause, size, location (latitude and longitude, legal land description, and forest area), time and duration, weather conditions, staffing and physical resources used to suppress the fire, and area burned. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Forestry and Parks. Its tags are wildfire data, wildfires. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-03-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
